steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice**.
steps.context: > Thrive Apprentice

steps.raw_text: Click **Courses** in the left sidebar and open the course you want to drip.
steps.context: left sidebar and open the course you want to drip

steps.raw_text: Click the **Drip** tab at the top of the course overview.
steps.context: tab at the top of the course overview

steps.raw_text: Click **Create first Drip Campaign** (or **Add Campaign** if you already have one).
steps.context: (or Add Campaign if you already have one)

steps.raw_text: In the lightbox that appears, select one of the seven drip campaign templates.
Enter a **Campaign Name** to identify this schedule.
steps.context: identify this schedule

steps.raw_text: Click **Continue** to open the campaign configuration screen.
steps.context: open the campaign configuration screen

steps.raw_text: Configure the **Start Event**—this determines when the drip countdown begins (e.g., on product purchase, on enrollment, or on a specific date).
steps.context: this determines when the drip countdown begins (e.g., on product purchase, on en

steps.raw_text: Set the **Unlock Intervals**—define how much time passes between each content unlock (e.g., 1 day, 1 week, 1 month).
steps.context: define how much time passes between each content unlock (e.g., 1 day, 1 week, 1

steps.raw_text: Click **Save** to apply the drip schedule to your course.
steps.context: apply the drip schedule to your course

steps.raw_text: Open your course and go to the **Drip** tab.
steps.context: tab

steps.raw_text: Locate the lesson or module you want to customize within the drip timeline.
Click the lesson to open its **Unlock Conditions** settings.
steps.context: settings

steps.raw_text: Choose a condition type—options include time-based delays, completion of a previous lesson, or a specific calendar date.
To add multiple conditions, click **Add Condition** and configure each one. When multiple conditions are set, the lesson unlocks only after all conditions are met.
steps.context: and configure each one. When multiple conditions are set, the lesson unlocks onl

steps.raw_text: Click **Save** to apply the custom unlock conditions.
steps.context: apply the custom unlock conditions

steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice**.
steps.context: > Thrive Apprentice

steps.raw_text: Click **Products** in the left sidebar and then click **Add Product**.
steps.context: left sidebar and then click Add Product

steps.raw_text: Name your product and configure the pricing through your payment integration (e.g., WooCommerce, ThriveCart, or SendOwl).
Under the product's **Access** settings, add your dripped course as protected content.
steps.context: settings, add your dripped course as protected content

steps.raw_text: Assign the drip campaign to the product—this ensures that students who purchase this product follow the drip schedule you configured.
Set up **Access Restriction Rules** so that only students who have purchased the product can view the course content.
steps.context: so that only students who have purchased the product can view the course content

steps.raw_text: Click **Save** to finalize your product configuration.
steps.context: finalize your product configuration
